主要内容: PacificHealth Laboratories, Inc. issued a press release on March 7, 2012, announcing its financial results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2011. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The report is filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, and the company's financial results are detailed in the press release. The press release is part of the company's disclosure requirements under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing includes the full text of the press release and is signed by Stephen P. Kuchen, the Chief Financial Officer of PacificHealth Laboratories, Inc.
